caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a reddish-brown finish positioned at an angle to show two sides. The table has a rectangular top with a drop-leaf on the right side, supported by four straight legs. The legs are connected by horizontal and diagonal stretcher bars, which have a decorative twisted design. There is a brass-colored handle on the shorter side of the table, indicating the presence of a drawer. The table is centered within a rectangular border, and the background is a plain, beige or off-white color. There is a faded or erased area on the right side of the background, and the signature "Henry Granet" is visible in the lower right corner outside the border.
title: Drop-Leaf Table
